nodes.label: qylock Lock Screen
nodes.author: Darkkal44
nodes.rationale: Uses Quickshell + PAM so the lock screen can share the Material You Dark theme with SDDM and the rest of the desktop.

nodes.label: App Launcher
nodes.rationale: Single search box serves three modes at once (app search, inline calculator, web/file search) so users never switch launchers; web and file search are toggleable to keep the list quiet.

nodes.label: Bar (Five Layouts)
nodes.rationale: Offers the four fixed Waybar-era layouts (Default, Default 2, Minimal, Sleek) for familiarity plus a fully editable Custom bar; Custom starts as a copy of Default so users can migrate incrementally, and 'Start over from…' resets to any Waybar layout.

nodes.label: Control Center
nodes.rationale: Groups the infrequent/power features (bar layout, themes, dynamic colors, wallpaper, clipboard, capture, emoji, cheatsheet) into one page-based panel, keeping the bar itself minimal.

nodes.label: Custom Bar Editor
nodes.rationale: Noctalia-style left/center/right widget lanes with add/remove/reorder/configure, three bar styles (separate pills, floating one-piece, edge-attached one-piece) and per-widget color overrides — design intent is to make the bar configurable entirely from Settings with no file editing.

nodes.label: Keybind Scheme
nodes.rationale: Super is the single modifier for shell surfaces; Super+Shift is reserved for the less-used/secondary variants (control center, theme, wallpaper, clipboard, capture) so the two tiers stay predictable.

nodes.label: Material 3 Design System
nodes.rationale: Google Material Symbols (Rounded) for all icons, tonal widget bubbles, and frosted blur behind bar/panels — applied uniformly so third-party panels (qylock, polkit) share one visual language.

nodes.label: Material Polkit Password Prompt
nodes.rationale: Quickshell's own polkit agent replaces the KDE one so password prompts match the Material theme instead of looking foreign.

nodes.label: Power Menu
nodes.rationale: Asks for confirmation before lock/suspend/logout/reboot/shutdown to avoid accidental destructive actions.

nodes.label: qs IPC Scripting Interface
nodes.rationale: Every panel exposes `qs ipc call <surface> <action>` so keybinds, scripts and Dolphin servicemenus can drive the shell without duplicating launch logic.

nodes.label: Quickshell Desktop Shell
nodes.rationale: Everything (bar, launcher, notifications, power menu, control center, settings) is hand-written in QML under config/quickshell rather than assembled from existing shell widgets; it hot-reloads on file save.

nodes.label: Settings App
nodes.rationale: Single JSON-backed settings surface so every option is editable without touching QML; changes apply instantly rather than requiring a shell restart.

nodes.label: NVIDIA Open Kernel Modules
nodes.rationale: RTX 50 series (Blackwell) only works with NVIDIA's open kernel modules, so the installer selects nvidia-open for stock linux and nvidia-open-dkms + headers for other kernels; no kernel parameters are needed since recent drivers enable nvidia_drm.modeset and fbdev by default.

nodes.label: Anime-style avatar artwork (pink-purple female character portrait)
nodes.norm_label: anime-style avatar artwork (pink-purple female character portrait)

nodes.label: Hyprland (Lua config)
nodes.rationale: Hyprland 0.55+ supports Lua configuration, so the repo uses hyprland.lua + modules/ instead of a single declarative hyprland.conf — enabling real logic (e.g. installer commenting out NVIDIA env vars).

nodes.label: Dolphin File Manager Setup
nodes.rationale: Configured to act like a full desktop file manager without KDE Plasma: fixed Open With via archlinux-xdg-menu, Ark servicemenus, KDE dialogs for other apps, thumbnails everywhere.

nodes.label: Dynamic Colors (Material You)
nodes.rationale: Generates a palette per wallpaper with matugen (dark/light, 9 scheme styles) so the whole desktop follows the wallpaper instead of a fixed theme.

nodes.label: waybar/themes Directory (legacy)
nodes.rationale: The folder name is left over from Waybar: only theme files, theme-switcher.sh and weather.py survive there, now consumed by Quickshell. Kept to avoid rewriting every theme path.

nodes.label: active Symlink Theme Switching
nodes.rationale: Each app reads an `active` symlink in its themes folder, so switching between a static theme and matugen-generated dynamic.* files is a single atomic pointer change that all apps observe — no per-app rewrite logic.

nodes.label: Wallpaper to Colors Pipeline
nodes.rationale: wallpaper picked → matugen palette → dynamic.css/.conf/.lua/.colors → symlinks → apps reload. One generated palette fanned out per-app format keeps all apps in sync from a single source of truth.

nodes.label: isleap-dotfiles
nodes.rationale: A Hyprland rice built around a from-scratch Quickshell desktop instead of the usual Waybar/polybar stack; README states there is no hyprland.conf because Hyprland is configured in Lua (0.55+).

nodes.label: Dashboard
nodes.rationale: Four pages (Overview, Media, Wallpapers, Weather) on a reorderable 6-column card grid; with a one-piece bar it grows out of the bar itself (same color, no gap, curved meeting corners) for visual continuity.

nodes.label: Night Light (hyprsunset)
nodes.rationale: Sunset-to-sunrise scheduling derives its times from the weather data already fetched for the bar, avoiding a second location/astronomy source.

nodes.label: Weather Data (Open-Meteo)
nodes.rationale: Open-Meteo is keyless and free, so the bar widget, dashboard forecast and night-light sunset times all share one fetch path (waybar/weather.py).
